_note: Quests are listed in the tasks panel while active, in this order. trigger: "start" (new game), "manual" (only via a { "startQuest": id } effect) or { "when": condition }.
title: survive the first night
doneLog: A grey light spreads over the water. Your first night on the island is behind you.
Daybreak reveals the empty sea once more. You have survived the night.
The sky brightens above the shore, and with it comes the knowledge that you have endured your first night.

title: catch a fish
doneLog: A first fish! Slippery and cold though it is, the catch represents a real advance.
The sea has provided your first fish, and with it some hope of regular food.
At last a fish is secured. Hunger need not be your immediate enemy today.

title: climb the cliff
doneLog: From the cliff top the newly revealed country extends farther inland than you had imagined.
The difficult ascent is accomplished. Beyond the cliff lies a far more extensive island than the beach suggested.

title: build a shelter
startLog: All night the wind found its way to you. A shelter raised against the rocks would exclude much of it.
Another night exposed to the wind would be a severe trial. Your first concern must be shelter.
doneLog: The wind strikes the outer logs, but within the shelter the air is almost still.
A rough habitation now stands beside the rocks, sufficient at least to defend you against the wind.

title: cut logs
doneLog: You have obtained sound logs, straight enough for the heavier work of construction.
The first proper timber is ready for use; building on a larger scale is now possible.

title: make a bed
doneLog: You stretch yourself upon the new bed, grateful to be raised above the cold ground.
The bed is hardly luxurious, yet its dry frame affords a comfort unknown upon the bare sand.

title: build a rain barrel
doneLog: The hollowed barrel has been placed beneath the eaves, ready to collect the next rain.
With the barrel established, even a passing shower may contribute to your water supply.

title: build a drying rack
doneLog: The drying rack now stands beside the fire, capable of preserving fish or meat for less favourable days.
You have contrived a rack upon which the fire's warmth may turn fresh food into lasting provisions.

title: build a fish trap
doneLog: The woven trap is set in the current. The river must now do its part.
Willow twigs and patient workmanship have provided a means of catching fish without a spear.

title: set snares
doneLog: Your snares stand ready across the small animal paths.
The running nooses have been arranged along the tracks; only time will show their worth.

title: dig a corn field
doneLog: The soil is broken and sown. If conditions remain favourable, the crop should ripen within three days.
Rows of newly turned earth now conceal the seed. For the moment, the work belongs to sun and rain.

title: build a bee hive
doneLog: The hollow hive stands among the flowers, awaiting its industrious occupants.
You have provided a dwelling for the wild bees; whether they accept it remains to be seen.

title: build a fish weir
doneLog: A barrier of stone and timber now crosses the river, allowing water through while detaining fish.
The weir is complete. The current passes its stones, but the fish should find no easy passage out.

title: better sleep
startLog: For sounder rest, establish a bed beneath shelter and maintain a fire there. The rocks on the beach already afford a natural refuge.
doneLog: A sheltered bed and a fire now offer the means of complete recovery, provided you retire before midnight.
